semiconductor_relevance: High — Daihen specializes in material handling systems and robotics specifically designed for semiconductor manufacturing, making it a key player in the equipment segment.
summary: DAIHEN Corporation provides advanced material handling solutions for the semiconductor industry, leveraging over 40 years of expertise in wafer and LCD panel handling. Their innovative handling robots utilize non-contact, high-precision technology to address challenges in advanced package panel handling, contributing to efficiency and space-saving in semiconductor manufacturing environments.
capabilities: SCARA arm technology for vacuum handling
